motions.label: Fade up
motions.description: Everything rises 56 px and fades in, one block after the other.

motions.label: Cascade
motions.description: The title slides in from the left out of a blur, then each block falls into place behind it.

motions.label: Slide left
motions.description: Content travels 200 px from the right edge towards the left.

motions.label: Slide right
motions.description: Content travels 200 px from the left edge towards the right.

motions.label: Drop
motions.description: Falls from above and lands with an overshoot, slightly crooked on the way down.

motions.label: Zoom
motions.description: Grows from a speck out of a blur.

motions.label: Zoom out
motions.description: Starts huge and close to the camera, then settles back to size.

motions.label: Blur in
motions.description: No movement: a heavy blur resolves into the text.

motions.label: Focus
motions.description: A camera pulling focus: content and background start blurred and enlarged, then sharpen in turn.

motions.label: Wipe
motions.description: Each block is uncovered from left to right.

motions.label: Curtain
motions.description: The title is let down like a curtain; blocks open from their middle outwards.

motions.label: Flip
motions.description: Each block turns up on a hinge at its top edge, in 3D.

motions.label: Pop
motions.description: Springs up from nothing and overshoots a little.

motions.label: Rise
motions.description: Text climbs out of a hidden line below it; blocks follow, slower.

motions.label: Typewriter
motions.description: The title is typed one character at a time; blocks flicker on after it.

motions.label: Glitch
motions.description: A short RGB split and jitter on entry, then still.

motions.label: Spotlight
motions.description: The slide is dark, a soft circle of light opens from the middle and the content settles into it.

motions.label: Swing
motions.description: Hangs from its top-left corner and swings into place like a sign.

motions.label: Rubber
motions.description: Stretches and squashes like rubber before it settles.
motions.use: fun deck, short list, big word

motions.label: Parallax
motions.description: Title, body and background travel different distances at different speeds.
motions.use: hero or statement over a background

motions.label: Count
motions.description: Cards rise in turn and each big figure rolls up from behind a line.

backgrounds.label: Aurora
backgrounds.description: Soft blobs of the accent colours drifting on slow orbits (the Aurora component).

backgrounds.label: Shader
backgrounds.description: Slow folds of coloured light with contour lines, drawn on the GPU (the Shader component).

backgrounds.label: Grid
backgrounds.description: A fine grid drifting diagonally and fading towards the edges, over a faint glow.

backgrounds.label: Mesh
backgrounds.description: Three big soft blobs of colour on slow, different orbits.

backgrounds.label: Noise
backgrounds.description: Film grain flickering at about 8 fps over a faint glow.

backgrounds.label: Dots
backgrounds.description: A lattice of dots drifting, with a second lattice turning slowly over it.

backgrounds.label: Waves
backgrounds.description: Three layers of sine curves sliding sideways at different speeds.

backgrounds.label: Spotlight
backgrounds.description: One large pool of light wandering across the slide and a smaller one answering it.

backgrounds.label: Stars
backgrounds.description: Three fields of dots that twinkle and drift at different speeds.

backgrounds.label: Gradient
backgrounds.description: A wide wash of the two accents turning slowly around the middle.
